searchTools:
**MINIMUM 8 keywords required** (tool will reject fewer).
**Build your query:** - Action verbs: get, fetch, create, add, new, update, modify, delete, browse, search, download, import - Entity types: page, section, post, image, navigation, entry - Example: "get page create add new section browse image download update"
**After search, verify:** - Need to CREATE something? → Must have "create*" tool - Need to UPDATE something? → Must have "update*" tool - Need images? → Must have image-related tools - Missing any? Search again with different keywords.
**CRITICAL:** "add another" / "new" = CREATE tool, not UPDATE tool!
